portfolio_desc: I shoot on a phone. Not because it's all I have — because it's always there, and moments aren't. Some of these happened in a second — a turn of light, someone moving through a frame. Others I returned to, stayed with, waited on until they became what I needed them to be. All of them started with something that stopped me long enough to reach for my pocket.
series_eclipse: Everyone carries a quieter version of themselves. Calmer, more real, harder to reach. Most of the time, everything else is too loud for it to surface. This series was about creating the conditions where it could. Unusual setups, close distances, real stillness, and subjects willing to sit inside that with me. The work that came back was unlike anything I'd made before. Quiet on the surface. The loudest frames I've ever shot.
series_portraits: Most people have a face they give the camera. These aren't those. A portrait only works for a second. Before that, there's too much self-consciousness. After that it's gone. These are from that second. Wherever I could find it, whoever was willing to stay still long enough.
series_random_stories: These don't belong to one place. They were made wherever I happened to be. Moving through, passing through, just there. The only thing they have in common is that I almost didn't take them.
series_abstract: Colour, pattern, texture. Things that were already there. You just have to stop trying to take in everything at once.
